exposure: Timing of cesarean section with respect to onset of labor or rupture of membranes
onset of labor or rupture of membranes
cohort: Women-infant dyads from the Consortium on Safe Labor dataset, with women having unlabored cesarean section at ≥37 + 0 week gestation
finding: Neonates of GBS-colonized women who underwent a planned cesarean section after the onset of labor or rupture of membranes had a significantly higher sepsis rate (4.5%).
mod_finding: Neonates of GBS-colonized women having a planned cesarean section after onset of labor or rupture of membranes are at increased risk of sepsis.
